class.name: CrimsonSteamProvider
class.brief_description: Uses the signed-in Steam client for private online games, verified peer identity, and native Steam transport.

members.member: Expected Steam AppID for this game. Zero accepts the AppID selected by Steam when the process starts. Configure the provider before attaching the game.
Steam P2P virtual port used by the host, from 0 to 65535. Zero is the standard Steam P2P port. This value is independent of the direct UDP port.
Game-specific identifier checked when joining a Steam lobby. Use the same value on host and guests. Use 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

signal.name: invite_received
signal.description: Emitted when Steam asks the running client to join a lobby. Submit the listing to [method CrimsonGame.join_online] after the user accepts it in your game.
